In the distant past...When this tower burned in a fire,
three nameless Pokémon perished in it.Then, a rainbow-hued Pokémon
descended from the sky and somehow brought them back...The people were afraid of power such as
the rainbow-hued Pokémon had shown.They tried to control it by force.The nameless Pokémon made no attempt
to fight back. Instead, their great sorrow compelled them to leave.This legend has been passed down
by the Ecruteak Gym Leader. Me?I was a Trainer way back when.
Ho ho ho!
